skill.name: pypict-skill
skill.description: Guidance for generating pairwise test cases from factors, values, and coverage needs.
skill.summary: Generate pairwise test cases for efficient coverage planning.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged two hardcoded URLs in SKILL.md. Both URLs are GitHub source references in metadata and prose, not executable network calls. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the reviewed skill text.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL on line 4 is a source metadata reference to a GitHub file. The skill contains no executable code or instruction to fetch that URL.
The URL on line 22 is a Markdown link to the source repository for documentation. It does not direct the agent to make a network request or transmit data.

content.value_statement: Large input matrices make complete testing slow and costly. This skill helps create pairwise test sets that improve coverage with fewer cases.
actual_capabilities: Guides pairwise test generation from user-provided factors and values.
Helps reduce large test matrices into smaller coverage-focused sets.
Supports planning for QA, product validation, and configuration testing.
Provides a reusable prompt context for pairwise testing tasks.
Helps describe generated cases in a format suitable for manual review.
limitations: Does not include executable generation code or a bundled test runner.
Does not automatically validate that every pair is covered.
Requires users to provide factors, values, and constraints.
May need review for domain-specific risk or regulatory coverage.

use_cases.title: Create QA Coverage Sets
use_cases.description: Generate a compact set of pairwise cases for browser, plan, region, and device combinations.

use_cases.title: Plan Configuration Tests
use_cases.description: Reduce configuration combinations while keeping useful coverage across important settings.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Test Matrices
use_cases.description: Turn product options into reviewable test cases for a release checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Pairwise Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a small factor list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pypict-skill to generate pairwise test cases for these factors: [list factors and values]. Return a concise table and note assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Add Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pypict-skill to create pairwise cases for these factors. Exclude these invalid combinations: [constraints]. Explain any skipped cases.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pypict-skill to produce pairwise cases and prioritize high-risk values. Mark cases that cover critical payment, auth, or migration paths.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Matrix
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for improving a test plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pypict-skill to review this test matrix for pairwise coverage gaps. Suggest a smaller or stronger set of cases.

output_examples.input: Factors: browser Chrome or Firefox, plan Free or Pro, region US or EU.
output_examples.output: A compact table of cases that pairs each browser, plan, and region value with every other factor at least once.

output_examples.input: A release matrix with operating system, language, payment method, and account type.
output: A reduced set of test cases for manual execution.
A short assumptions section for excluded or missing values.
A coverage note that calls out high-risk combinations.

best_practices: List every factor and value before requesting generation.
State invalid combinations and required combinations clearly.
Review the generated cases against business-critical paths.
anti_patterns: Do not use pairwise coverage as a replacement for risk-based tests.
Do not omit constraints that make combinations impossible.
Do not accept generated cases without checking domain rules.

faq.question: What does this skill help generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate pairwise test cases from factors and values supplied by the user.

faq.question: Does it run a test generation tool?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance and prompt context, but it does not include executable code.

faq.question: Can it handle constraints?
faq.answer: Yes, if you provide the invalid or required combinations in the prompt.

faq.question: Is pairwise testing complete coverage?
faq.answer: No. Pairwise testing covers value pairs, but it does not replace full coverage for critical workflows.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide factors, allowed values, constraints, and any combinations that need extra attention.
